properties.evidence: `KvBackend` lives in dynograph-foundation, not reflow2, so until the absorption's increment 5 brings dynograph-storage in-tree, swapping the byte store means changing another repository — which dec:idea-dynograph-crates-independent-in-code-coupled-in-release says reflow2's design has no standing to decide. Absorb first, then swap. The dependency also runs the other way in scope: if SQLite (option F) were taken it would subsume tantivy too, so increment 5 would absorb less than currently planned.
